name: Fairquery Company Jobs Feed
description: Live job listings from employers' own public Greenhouse, Lever and Ashby boards, with posting age, long-open and repost signals, board discovery and open/closed checks. Free tools run locally without an account; an optional multi-company search runs the Apify Actor on the user's own Apify account.
author: Fairquery

APIFY_TOKEN.description: Optional. Your own Apify API token, only needed for the paid jobs_search_companies tool (billed to your Apify account). Free tools work without it.
